handoff.purpose: Defines helper functions for edge keys and field deduplication, and begins the resolve_type_graph entry point with node registration for types and fields.

symbols.name: _edge_key
symbols.note: Returns a canonical tuple for an edge dict, used for deduplication.

symbols.name: _dedupe_fields
symbols.note: Deduplicates FieldDecl records by (owner, name) using _field_rank; keeps the best per key.

symbols.name: _field_rank
symbols.note: Returns a tuple for ranking FieldDecl: annotation first, then origin rank, then line, then name.

symbols.name: _member_names
symbols.note: Returns the set of member names (fields and methods) for a given qualname, used for structural matching.

symbols.name: resolve_type_graph
symbols.note: Entry point that resolves raw per-file type facts into a TypeGraph; begins with pass 1 registering type nodes and field nodes.

claims.text: One record per (owner, name). An annotated origin wins; ``_ORIGIN_RANK`` breaks the rest.
claims.why: Code iterates over fields, uses (owner, name) as key, and compares using _field_rank which gives annotation precedence and then uses _ORIGIN_RANK.

claims.text: parse.py emits TWO records for a member written both as a class-body annotation and as ``self.x = ...`` on purpose -- they are two facts about one member, and choosing between them is a whole-repo judgement that lives here.
claims.why: The claim about parse.py behavior is outside this chunk; the deduplication logic is present but the emission claim cannot be verified.

claims.text: The member-name set used for structural (Protocol) matching. Methods and fields both count: a Protocol may declare either.
claims.why: Function collects names from both fields and signatures for the given owner qualname, returning a frozenset.
The type of facts_by_rel is declared but the actual data is not in this chunk; the function uses it as expected.

claims.text: ``imports_by_file`` rel -> rels, i.e. ``index["import_edges"]`` -- REUSED, never recomputed. Absent means "no imports known", which degrades to same-file resolution only.
claims.why: Code uses imports_by_file or defaults to empty dict; if absent, imports dict is empty, leading to same-file resolution only.
PlainNaming is referenced but not defined in this chunk; the default assignment is present but the interface is not verifiable.

claims.text: ``languages``      ``index["languages"]``, so coverage can report every non-Python language as ``not_supported`` rather than 0.
claims.why: The languages parameter is accepted but not used in this chunk; its effect is outside this code.

claims.text: ``ignored``        rels whose facts are withheld, exactly as ``all_units`` withholds units for out-of-scope files.
claims.why: Code creates skip set from ignored and filters facts and imports accordingly.

claims.text: ``hub_cap``        max fan-in a type may have and still keep its ``consumes``/``produces`` edges. 0 disables.
claims.why: hub_cap is accepted but not used in this chunk; its effect is in later passes not present.
